Combined Attack.name: Combined Attack
Combined Attack.special: Allows any two martial attacks with any two limbs. Speed for both is the longer of the two attacks.

Stunning Head Blow.name: Stunning Head Blow
Stunning Head Blow.special: Two martial punches to either side of the head. Doubles chance of unconsciousness per point of physical damage (from 2% to 4%)

Eye Gouge.name: Eye Gouge
Eye Gouge.special: Two simultaneous Finger Punches if either are successful then an Eye Gouge is made for each. Success equals equals permanent eye loss.

Death Strike.name: Death Strike
Death Strike.special: vs. 6 or less armor. Attacker must be within 2' of target height. Rake against the neck or Hell Strike to the nose. Causes immediate death if success.

Feather Block.name: Feather Block
Feather Block.special: Combined with any other block, +1 second. If successful all damage is mitigated.

Crushing Hold.name: Crushing Hold
Crushing Hold.special: Combined with any other hold. Does 3d6 crushing damage per 5 seconds to held areas.

Punch Throw.name: Punch Throw
Punch Throw.special: Martial Punch to the upper body combined with a Leg Throw. Must make Martial Punch first to roll this skill in place of the Leg Throw.

Kick Throw.name: Kick Throw
Kick Throw.special: Martial Kick to the lower body combined with a Arm, Shoulder or Body Throw. Must make Martial Kick first to roll this skill in place of the Throw.

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.special: Added to any Throw (except leg). Make a STR Save with skill roll. If both are successful, 1d6 damage per 5 full points of STR. +2 seconds to throw used.

Martial Disarm.name: Martial Disarm
Martial Disarm.special: Disarm an opponent as a contest of this skill roll versus the oppenent's AGL Save. If made by quarter and opponent loses AGL Save the weapon can be taken instead of disarm.

Flip.name: Flip
Flip.special: Cannot attack. If successful -4 to be hit. Fail requires AGL Save to land on their feet.

Wall Jump.name: Wall Jump
Wall Jump.special: Combined with jump or flying move, adds +2 more AGL for jump moves.
